approval_scope: Approved on 2026-09-18 for local, zero-retention Plaid Sandbox schema and aggregate data-quality analysis only. This does not accept a canonical contract, feature set, model dataset, runtime connector, direction policy, money normalisation, or payment action. ADR-018 (2026-09-22) separately accepts a money-normalisation rule and a direction policy, but only for deriving S01/S02/S04 showcase-fixture facts; it does not widen this scope to a canonical contract, feature set, model dataset, or runtime connector.
scope: Plaid Sandbox /transactions/sync added transaction observations only

mapping.handling: Generate an internal immutable source-observation ID. Do not relabel Plaid transaction_id as a source event ID.
limitations: The source-event ID generation and idempotency contract are not accepted.

mapping.handling: Set to plaid_sandbox for the observed environment.
limitations: Does not establish a production provider mapping.

mapping.handling: Do not map next_cursor to a per-transaction source revision. A cursor is a page-level checkpoint, not a record revision.
limitations: Modified and removed event semantics remain indeterminate in the bounded probe.

mapping.handling: Classify the observed sync patch as source_observed only after the event-type vocabulary is accepted; added does not prove when the payment occurred.
limitations: Initial historical sync also uses added; modification and removal mappings require separate review.

mapping.handling: Do not derive from transaction dates or notebook execution time.
limitations: Blocks point-in-time velocity features and production feature parity.

mapping.handling: Derive a keyed pseudonym at the provider boundary for source lineage. Do not persist or expose the raw Plaid transaction_id.
limitations: The approved keyed pseudonymisation method and key lifecycle do not yet exist.

mapping.handling: Pseudonymise before any persistence outside the provider boundary.
limitations: No customer-level reference was approved from the observed source.

mapping.handling: Do not map date directly to canonical event_time. For pending transactions it is the occurrence date; for posted transactions it is the posting date. Preserve it only as source metadata until a state-aware time policy is accepted.
limitations: $.added[].datetime and authorized_datetime were null in the observed run; date semantics differ by pending state.

mapping.handling: Do not map floating-point source money to minor units until currency exponent, source amount semantics, rounding, and sign policy are approved.
limitations: No canonical money conversion is implemented.

mapping.handling: Use only with an approved money-normalisation policy and validate ISO 4217 input. Account for the mutually exclusive unofficial_currency_code path.
limitations: The bounded Sandbox run observed a non-null ISO code but does not establish all-provider availability.

mapping.handling: Plaid documents positive amounts as money moving out of the account and negative amounts as money moving in. Derive direction only after an approved sign, product-scope, and normalisation policy.
limitations: The canonical direction policy and its interaction with the money-normalisation blocker are not accepted.

mapping.handling: Candidate categorical mapping; enumerations are not yet accepted.
Do not collapse Plaid primary, detailed, and versioned categories into one neutral canonical category. Retain provider taxonomy only after an approved category structure exists.
limitations: No neutral category taxonomy or versioned category object has been accepted.

mapping.handling: Do not map a merchant location country to an ambiguous canonical country_code. Define whether the canonical field means merchant location, account country, payment origin, or another concept first.
limitations: Location country is nullable and is not evidence of account, customer, or payment-origin country.

mapping.handling: Do not persist names; an approved pseudonymisation and primary-counterparty rule is required first.
limitations: Entity ID was nullable and merchant_name was nullable in the observed inventory.

decision_recommendation: Accepted only as a boundary for local zero-retention Sandbox analysis. Do not implement a runtime connector, canonical transformation, model feature set, or payment action from this artifact.
